attackers_goals: An attacker attempts to change Active Directory configuration for persistence or defense evasion. With a modified Device Registration policy, an attacker might be able to access the tenant without possible blockage for later access.
description: An identity changed the Device Registration policy.
investigative_actions: Check what policy has been changed. Check whether the user changing the configuration is permitted to perform such actions.
